independent_verification: Reuse the original independent outer verifier body through a private new fixed-auditor binding. followup_numerical_progression_rule: Both cases must converge all five fixed-and-fresh continuous windows, improve original-discrete fresh convergence versus the control, have no local/discrete guard, pass0.03m original-discrete RMS and have median original-discrete RMS no worse than the control. scope: No numeric real reference labels, physical pose-error score, new continuous trajectory, native/default adoption, vehicle integration or timing claim. Matrix roles, selection checks and round states reuse existing observations
